title: B♭ major, low B♭ to double high B♭

details.title: B♭ major, low B♭ to double high B♭
details.lead: The trumpet’s own scale, open low B♭ to double high B♭, every note: one octave at a time, then all three in one breath each way, then the whole horn from double high B♭ down to the bottom F, and last, slowly, a half note to every note. Rest a moment at the top of each run.
facts: Low octave: B♭3 to B♭4, Middle octave: B♭4 to B♭5, High octave: B♭5 to double high B♭6, Low B♭3 to double high B♭6, up and down, Every note on the horn: F3 to B♭6, Slow, a half note each: B♭3 to B♭6 and back
